claims.statement: One source (the Rent Roll spreadsheet) lists Kestrel Point Logistics Center's building area as 128,400 square feet.
A second source (a CSV sheet) lists the building area as 133,750 square feet.
A third source (a PDF comparable-set extract) states the building area as 121,900 square feet.

citations.quote:
Kestrel Point Logistics Center is carried in the comparable set at a building area of 121,900
square feet.

claims.statement: A fourth source (another CSV sheet, using a slightly different property name) lists the building area as 118,300 square feet.

The four sources do not agree on Kestrel Point Logistics Center's building area, reporting four different values (128,400 SF, 133,750 SF, 121,900 SF, and 118,300 SF) for what appears to be the same property.
